z-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Linani lemvelo ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30.
z-m-36-01.title: Iimeko ezimbini ezikhokelela kwindawo enye: ubudlelwane bazo enye kwenye buthini?
z-m-36-01.topic: Oko unokukwazi nokungakwaziyo xa iimeko ezimbini zikhokelela kwimeko enye (ukuqukwa kweeseti zenyaniso)
z-m-36-01.goal: Ukusuka kulwazi lwe-'ukuba p ngoko q' kunye ne-'ukuba r ngoko q' ziyinyaniso kuphela, hlela iingxelo ezigqityiweyo neezo zingagqitywanga ngokuqukwa kweeseti zenyaniso, bonisa ezingagqitywanga ngemizekelo echasayo, uze uthi kufuneka ntoni enye ukuzigqiba.
z-m-36-01.material:
Ngeseti epheleleyo U, cinga ngeemeko ezintathu p, q, r. Vumela iiseti zenyaniso zazo zibe nguP, Q, R. Izinto kuphela ozaziyo zezi zimbini.
(가) Indululo 'ukuba p ngoko q' iyinyaniso. (P yiseti engaphantsi ye-Q.)
(나) Indululo 'ukuba r ngoko q' iyinyaniso. (R yiseti engaphantsi ye-Q.)
Akukho nto yaziwayo malunga nobudlelwane phakathi kuka-P no-R. Ukuze uqonde ngamagama kuphela, ngaphandle komfanekiso, ungayizoba njenge-'P ingaphakathi kwe-Q kwaye R ingaphakathi kwe-Q nayo'.
z-m-36-01.thinking.0: Ukwahlula oko kugqityiweyo lulwazi olunikiweyo noko 'okungaziwayo'
z-m-36-01.thinking.1: Ukugweba ngokuguqula iimeko zibe kukuqukwa kweeseti zenyaniso
z-m-36-01.thinking.2: Ukwakha imizekelo echasayo wena ukubonisa 'akuhlali kunyaniso'
z-m-36-01.thinking.3: Ukuthetha ukuba luluphi ulwazi olulahlekileyo ukugqiba isigqibo
z-m-36-01.prereq.0: Ukuba xa indululo 'ukuba p ngoko q' iyinyaniso, iseti yenyaniso P yiseti engaphantsi ye-Q, kwaye ukuchasayo kunexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nendululo yokuqala (ucinga umfundi ufunde inxalenye yokuqala yeMathematika Eqhelekileyo 'iiseti nezindululo'; H2 yilebhile yobunzima yalo msebenzi wemveliso kuphela, hayi ukubekwa kwibanga)
z-m-36-01.prereq.1: Intsingiselo ye-union, intersection kunye ne-complement, nemiphindaphindo nabahlululi
z-m-36-01.s.s1.prompt: Wazi (가) kunye (나) kuphela, khetha zonke iingxelo ongazigqiba njengezinyaniso rhoqo. (Musa ukukhetha iingxelo ezingenakugqitywa.)
z-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba imifanekiso emibini okanye ngaphezulu eyahlukileyo ene-P ne-R nganye ibekwe ngaphakathi kwe-Q. (Umzekelo, umfanekiso apho ziyagqubana, nomnye apho zingagqubani.)
z-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.1: Phinda ubhale ingxelo nganye njenge-ukuqukwa okunjengo 'P yiseti engaphantsi ye-Q' uhlole ukuba yinyaniso kumfanekiso ngamnye owuzobileyo. Ikho ingxelo ixabiso layo lenyaniso litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kumfanekiso?
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.a: Konke okwaziwayo kukuba P no-R zombini zingaphakathi kwe-Q. Ukuba ngaphakathi kweseti enye akuthethi ukuba enye iquka enye. Zoba nemifanekiso apho iiseti ezimbini zingagqubani okanye enye kuphela inkulu.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba hayi q, ngoko hayi p
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.b: Ufunde (가) iguqulelwe kwi-contrapositive. Esi sigwebo sisebenzisa inyaniso yokuba i-contrapositive inexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nendululo yokuqala.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.c: Oku kukuchasayo kuka-(나). Nokuba indululo iyinyaniso, ukuchasayo kwayo kunokuba yinyaniso okanye ngobuxoki. Zoba umfanekiso apho Q inokuba nkulu kune-R.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.d: Ukuba p okanye r, ngoko q
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.d: Esi sigwebo sihlola ukuba inxalenye edibeneyo ye-P ne-R ingena na ngaphakathi kwe-Q. Ukuba nganye ingaphakathi kwe-Q, indibaniselwano ikwangaphakathi kwe-Q.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.e: Ukuba p kunye no-r, ngoko q
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.e: Esi sigwebo sihlola ukuba inxalenye eqhelekileyo ye-P ne-R ingena na ngaphakathi kwe-Q. Inxalenye eqhelekileyo kwayinxalenye ye-P. Cinga nangemeko apho inxalenye eqhelekileyo ingenanto.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.f: Ukuba hayi r, ngoko hayi p
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.f: Le ngxelo yi-contrapositive ye-'ukuba p ngoko r'. Ukuba loo ngxelo ayigqitywanga, le ayigqitywanga nayo.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.explain: Okugqityiweyo ku-(가) kunye no-(나) kukuphela oko kulandela ngokuthe ngqo kwi-P⊂Q ne-R⊂Q. 'Ukuba hayi q, ngoko hayi p' yi-contrapositive ka-(가), 'ukuba p okanye r, ngoko q' yi-P∪R⊂Q, kwaye 'ukuba p kunye no-r, ngoko q' yi-P∩R⊂Q. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, 'ukuba p, ngoko r' (P⊂R) kunye ne-contrapositive yayo, kunye 'nokuba q, ngoko r' (Q⊂R), zinokuba yinyaniso okanye ngobuxoki ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela P, R, kunye ne-Q ezibekwe ngayo, ngoko azigqitywa ngolu lwazi lodwa. 'Akugqitywanga' kwahlukile kwi-'ngobuxoki'.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku masijonge imeko ethile. Iseti epheleleyo U ngamanani endalo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30. q ithi 'iqhelekile', p ithi 'iyimiphindaphindo ye-4', kwaye r ithi 'iyimiphindaphindo ye-6'. Ngoko (가) kunye no-(나) zombini ziyinyaniso. Fumana ufake amanani ama-3 ahlukeneyo x apho p iyinyaniso kodwa r ingobuxoki.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala dwelisa onke amanani asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30 anelisa imeko p (imiphindaphindo ye-4).
z-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwinani ngalinye owalidwelisileyo, hlola imeko r (ukuba iyimiphindaphindo ye-6), ugcine kuphela amanani angayanelisiyo.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.var.x: x (inani lendalo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30)
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c1: x kufuneka ibe linani lendalo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ayiyiyo imiphindaphindo ye-4, ngoko p ayiyonyaniso.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Ayiyiyo imiphindaphindo ye-6, ngoko r ingobuxoki.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Iyimiphindaphindo ye-6, ngoko r iyinyaniso. Kufuneka libe linani apho r ingobuxoki.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.explain: Ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30, imiphindaphindo ye-4 yi-4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, kwaye ukususa i-12 ne-24, eziyimiphindaphindo ye-6, kushiya i-4, 8, 16, 20, 28, ezanelisa imeko. Ukuba kukho linani linye elinje, 'ukuba p ngoko r' ingobuxoki. Nakule meko (가) kunye no-(나) zisaziyinyaniso, ngoko kuqinisekisiwe ukuba (가) kunye no-(나) kuphela azinakugqiba 'ukuba p ngoko r'.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.prompt: UJiho wathi, "p kunye no-r zombini zingaphakathi kwe-q, ngoko 'ukuba p ngoko r' kufuneka ibe yinyaniso nayo." Bhala oko ucinga ngengxelo kaJiho. Bhala nokuba oko ndakukhetha kuqala kwi-s1 kutshintshe (okanye kwahlala kunjalo) emva kokwenza i-s2, uze ubhale ukuba kufuneka ulwazi olungakumbi luni ukugqiba ukuba 'ukuba p ngoko r' iyinyaniso.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha elinye lamanani owawenzileyo kwi-s2 uqale ubhale ukuba p no-r nganye iyinyaniso okanye ngobuxoki.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ingxelo enye ngakumbi exhuma ngqo p no-r iya kuba nemo enjani, uhlole ukuba inani olikhethe ngoku lisakwazi ukwenzeka xa loo ngxelo ikhona.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kwinani endilinikileyo, ngaba kunokubonwa ngokucacileyo ukuba p iyinyaniso kwaye r ingobuxoki?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ukuba ulwazi olongezelelweyo endilukhankanyileyo lwalukhona, ngaba ndihlolile ngomzekelo omnye ukuba 'ukuba p ngoko r' iba yinyaniso ngokwenene?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.3: Ukuba oko ndakukhetha kuqala kwi-s1 kutshintshile, ngaba ndibhale ukuba kutheni kutshintshile, kwaye ukuba kwahlala kunjalo, ngeziphi iziseko?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.model.0: Ingxelo kaJiho ayinakugqitywa. 4 iyimiphindaphindo ye-4, ngoko p iyinyaniso, kodwa ayiyiyo imiphindaphindo ye-6, ngoko r ingobuxoki. Noko (가) kunye no-(나) ziyahlala ziyinyaniso, ngoko ukuba ngaphakathi kwe-q kuphela akwanelanga. Sifuna enye into exhuma ngqo p no-r, njengolwazi lokuba P ingaphakathi kwe-R.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Ukuba awukhethanga 'ukuba p ngoko r' kuqala, yimeko apho isigwebo sakho sahlala sinjalo, kwaye ungabhala ukuba ukuhlola ngomzekelo kwandise ukuqiniseka kwakho.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.model.1: Andikwazi ukuxela ukuba iyinyaniso. 16 iyimiphindaphindo ye-4 kodwa ayiyiyo imiphindaphindo ye-6, ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo. Kodwa ukuba sifunda 'ukuba q ngoko r' nayo, ngoko P ingaphakathi kwe-Q kwaye Q ingaphakathi kwe-R, ngoko P ingaphakathi kwe-R nayo, kwaye 'ukuba p ngoko r' iba yinyaniso. Ekuqaleni kwakubonakala kunokuba yinyaniso, kodwa ndafumana umzekelo ochasayo ndatshintsha ingqondo yam.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo enika ulwazi olutsha olunye kwaye ithi nesizathu sokuba lwanele. Imeko R=Q iba 'ukuba q ngoko r' xa idityaniswa no-(나), ngoko yenye indlela yokuthi impendulo efanayo.
